classification: M08 RESOLVED LOCAL-LIVE PROFILE — candidate for external review
claim_scope: modeled DNp01-dependent escape onset in the declared simplified circuit/controller
model_notice: Live model: 313-neuron MaleCNS-derived circuit. The neural model controls escape onset; walking and takeoff mechanics are simplified. The stimulus is feature-level/scalar, not reconstructed raw vision.
limitations: The model receives a simplified scalar looming signal. Strike direction is not reconstructed from fly vision.
M06 established modeled input dependence and DNp01 command authority, not biological looming selectivity.
The selected static-size control generated substantially more DNp01 activity than the selected looming trial.
This is not a biologically validated looming detector, natural fly escape, whole-CNS locomotion, or causal evidence in a living fly.
The live game executes the disclosed 313-neuron circuit; the audited 166,700-neuron graph is not the live game graph.
